report.summary: 4 findings processed: 2 confirmed, 1 narrowed, 1 needs-evidence. Items: audit spectral_evidence callers, fix GateResult.containment default, fix canary decoy-first check, fix warm_model budget egress tracking.
risks: GateResult.containment default fix may require schema migration for existing ledger entries
Budget egress tracking change may affect existing task budgets
Canary decoy-first fix may change existing canary statuses
Spectral evidence callers may need multiple updates
todos: Find GateResult definition and check containment default
Check OllamaProvider.caps and budget system for warm_model egress

items.title: Fix OllamaProvider warm_model egress not tracked by budget
items.why_now: Critical: warm_model makes HTTP request but claims local-only; budget system may not track egress, leading to unbilled costs or security bypass.

steps.do: Check OllamaProvider.caps to see if local=True. If so, change to local=False or add separate capability flag for warm_model egress.
Update budget system in daedalus/council/session.py to dynamically inspect actual host URL before deciding egress cost.
steps.verified_by: Run existing budget tests: python -m pytest tests/test_budget.py -v

items.assumption: Assumes OllamaProvider.caps sets local=True. If caps already accounts for warm_model, this item may be reduced.

items.title: Fix GateResult.containment default to avoid incomplete audit trail
items.why_now: High: if containment defaults to None, any construction path that omits it records incomplete gate result, weakening audit trail.

steps.do: Find GateResult class definition in daedalus/spine/attempt.py and check default value of containment field.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'class GateResult' daedalus/spine/attempt.py && grep -A 20 'class GateResult' daedalus/spine/attempt.py

steps.do: If containment defaults to None, change default to a sentinel or make field required. Update all instantiation sites.

items.assumption: Assumes GateResult has a containment field. If not, this item is invalid.

items.title: Fix check_anchoring false positive when decoy and correct answer both present
items.why_now: Medium: canary may report 'anchored_on_decoy' even when correct answer is present, causing false alarms.

steps.do: Inspect check_anchoring in daedalus/council/canary.py to see if it checks correct answer presence before returning decoy verdict.
If decoy check does not verify correct answer absence, add condition to only return 'anchored_on_decoy' if correct answer is absent.

items.assumption: Assumes check_anchoring exists and has the described behavior.

items.title: Audit spectral_evidence callers for missing key handling
items.why_now: Medium: callers may misinterpret missing modules as 'not measured' rather than 'not in graph', leading to incorrect analysis.

steps.do: Audit all callers of spectral_evidence: grep -rn 'spectral_evidence' daedalus/
steps.verified_by: Run audit command and verify output lists all callers

steps.do: For each caller, check if they handle missing keys (e.g., using .get() with default) and add documentation or explicit None check if needed.

items.assumption: Assumes spectral_evidence is defined in daedalus/eval/ceiling.py as per index.
